findings.claim: The generated manifest cannot satisfy the requirement to record the agent-team-creator worktree path and commit in `.agent-team/team.json` `native.*.version` because the manifest has no native version metadata.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria Risks / Trade-offs require: "record its path and commit in `.agent-team/team.json` `native.*.version` and in evidence." `buildManifest` returns only `{ schemaVersion, id, outcome, scope, harness, roles }`, and `nativeFor` emits per-role `claude`, `codex`, `opencode`, and `minimax` objects without any `version` field.
findings.suggested_fix: Add checked-in config fields for the agent-team-creator path and commit, emit them into the generated manifest under the required `native.*.version` location, and cover this in `build-manifest.test.mjs`.

findings.claim: `fhir-integration-specialist` owns `docs/interop/**`, but the change does not create that owned documentation path or README stub.
findings.evidence: The role header declares `owns: [docs/interop/**]`; the acceptance criteria task 1.2 requires owned doc paths with README stubs and the diff only adds `docs/integrations/README.md`, `docs/sync/README.md`, `docs/billing/README.md`, and `docs/compliance/README.md`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either add `docs/interop/README.md` with owner and PHI rule, or change the role to own an already-created path such as a subpath under `docs/integrations/`.
